examples.title: Basic theme switch
examples.description: Three positions on a sky and night track: Light, System, Dark. Click a position or use the arrow keys, Home and End; the switch reports the selected value.
examples.code: Selected: {theme}

examples.title: Disabled theme switch
examples.description: A disabled switch keeps its selection and ignores the pointer and the keyboard.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { ThemeSwitch } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<ThemeSwitch value="dark" label="Color theme" disabled />

examples.title: All three values
examples.description: The switch with Light, System and Dark selected in turn: a sky track with a raised thumb on the left, a neutral track in the middle and a night track on the right.
